    page_index += 1

steps.code:
# Compute total downloaded duration per album
from collections import defaultdict

album_durations = defaultdict(int)
for song in downloaded_songs:
    album_durations[song["album_id"]] += song["duration"]

print("Album durations from downloaded songs:")
for album_id, total_duration in album_durations.items():
    print(f"Album {album_id}: {total_duration} seconds ({total_duration/60:.1f} min)")

# Find albums with >= 900 seconds
eligible_albums = [album_id for album_id, total in album_durations.items() if total >= 900]
print(f"\nEligible albums (>= 900 sec): {eligible_albums}")
